def priority(adj, colors, sat, deg, uncolored_deg):
    mask = (colors < 0).astype(np.float64)
    n = adj.shape[0]
    dens = uncolored_deg.astype(np.float64)
    sat_f = sat.astype(np.float64)
    deg_f = deg.astype(np.float64)
    
    scores = sat_f * (n * n * 2.0) + dens * (n * 2.0) + deg_f
    return scores * mask
